reviewModes.label: Native 160 × 160
reviewModes.purpose: Judge real pixel clusters, silhouette, material grouping and readability without resampling.

reviewModes.label: Nearest-neighbour 4×
reviewModes.purpose: Inspect authored cluster decisions, joint edges and stray or crawling pixels.

reviewModes.label: 640 × 360 match composite
reviewModes.purpose: Judge gameplay scale, pose readability and physical-body separation from effects.

reviewModes.label: 320 × 180 thumbnail
reviewModes.purpose: Confirm the held pose and Frame identity remain readable at reduced presentation scale.

reviewModes.label: One-colour silhouette
reviewModes.purpose: Confirm Frame identity, action direction, weight and limb separation without surface detail.

reviewModes.label: Grayscale
reviewModes.purpose: Confirm value hierarchy, material separation and contact readability without hue.

criteria.label: Frame identity and silhouette
criteria.instruction: The exact Frame must remain recognisable through head, shoulder, forearm, torso, pelvis, lower-leg and foot masses. The pose must not collapse into generic giant-machine proportions.

criteria.label: Mechanical construction and landmarks
criteria.instruction: Cockpit, load paths, joints, declared hardpoints, service logic and signature asymmetry must remain mechanically coherent and attached to the approved construction landmarks.

criteria.label: Body-role choreography
criteria.instruction: The cel must clearly perform its exact bank, semantic role, phase, hero/contact responsibility and hold priority rather than merely depicting a plausible generic pose.

criteria.label: Motion identity and cadence
criteria.instruction: The held drawing must express the Frame-specific motion identity and cadence, including anticipation, commitment, contact or recovery emphasis appropriate to this slot.

criteria.label: Material, palette and lighting
criteria.instruction: Approved material ramps, selective contour clusters and stable upper-front gameplay light must survive without PBR gloss, airbrushed gradients, cyan-magenta soup or decorative glowing seams.

criteria.label: 1990s pixel authenticity and readability
criteria.instruction: Native-scale clusters must look deliberately authored for a premium 1994–1997 arcade/DOS fighter, with no resampled fuzz, filler detail, contact-sheet residue or provider-packed output behaviour.

criteria.label: Physical body and effect separation
criteria.instruction: The physical Frame body must remain fully readable on its own. Energy, smoke, impact or false-vector effects may not replace anatomy, hide weak posing or become fused into the body cel.

criteria.label: Continuity, hardpoint and mirror intent
criteria.instruction: Against the exact reference-manifest lineage, previous/next cel intent and declared mirror policy, joint lengths, hardpoints, weapon side, silhouette landmarks and panel detail must remain stable.
